leadStory: Alexander Isak was sent home from Sweden on Sunday with what Liverpool called a minor injury and Graham Potter a minor thigh problem, and Cody Gakpo was forced off after seventeen minutes of the Netherlands' 2-1 win in Serbia with a left-ankle injury, a scan due Monday, a fortnight before Manchester City visit Anfield.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is a pair of injury bulletins from international duty; neither resolves into a single Liverpool still. Antigravity should take no action.
